text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Through pure tenacity, Narita Taishin manages to win the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the mistakes made during training lead to her breaking under the weight of her mental and physical exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She confesses that she needs a break from both training and racing.
